parameters.label: Flow uplift, plant duty over IT reference

source.method: The gap an operator reads to judge whether the header is sized for the real duty. The card presents it as a ratio of two flows, and the registry's measured-wiring check refused that: perturbing anything that moves flow_lps leaves this number untouched. It is right to refuse — the delta-T and the IT load appear in BOTH flows and cancel, so the flow uplift is exactly the UPS loss fraction, 1/eta - 1, and nothing else. Declared as what it actually depends on.
